prompt: Implement a Python class LRUCache(capacity) with get(key) and put(key, value). get returns the value or -1 when absent. A get refreshes recency; putting an existing key updates it and refreshes recency; inserting beyond capacity evicts the least recently used key. Assume capacity is a positive integer. Return one Python code block containing only the class.
test_code:
import unittest

class LRUCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_and_basic_put_get(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('missing'), -1)
        cache.put('a', 1)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('a'), 1)

    def test_get_refreshes_recency(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put('a', 1)
        cache.put('b', 2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('a'), 1)
        cache.put('c', 3)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('b'), -1)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('a'), 1)

    def test_update_refreshes_recency(self):
        cache = LRUCache(2)
        cache.put('a', 1)
        cache.put('b', 2)
        cache.put('a', 9)
        cache.put('c', 3)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('a'), 9)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('b'), -1)

    def test_capacity_one(self):
        cache = LRUCache(1)
        cache.put(1, 'one')
        cache.put(2, 'two')
        self.assertEqual(cache.get(1), -1)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get(2), 'two')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
